appName.message: StreamMask – Hide Personal Info While Streaming

appDesc.message: For streamers: auto-masks phone numbers, e-mails, IDs, IBANs, cards and IPs with *****. Stream Mode hides history suggestions.

maskedNone.message: No personal info found on this page

autoSub.message: No setup needed: anything that looks like personal info becomes *****

alsoSub.message: Your name, street, username… type and press Enter

wordHint.message: 🔒 Don't type numbers, cards, IBANs or e-mails: they are caught automatically. This list stays on this device only and is never sent anywhere.

wordWarn.message: Don't type numbers, cards, IBANs or e-mails: they are caught automatically and never saved here.

streamSub.message: Hides history suggestions in the address bar

streamOff.message: Off. When on, your history is backed up inside the extension and removed from suggestions; it comes back when you turn it off. Nothing is deleted.

streamOn.message: $COUNT$ history entries kept safe, turned on $AGO$ ago.

streamOn2.message: Search suggestions and autofill are off too.

blockSub.message: Tabs with these sites are closed the moment Stream Mode turns on, and again if they open during the stream

blockedPageText.message: This site is on your Stream Mode block list. Turn Stream Mode off to open it.
